<title>Welcome to LWC Communities!</title>
<!-- branding stylesheets -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/slds/salesforce-lightning-design-system-part1.css?{ versionKey }"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/slds/salesforce-lightning-design-system-part2.css?{ versionKey }"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/slds/salesforce-lightning-design-system-part3.css?{ versionKey }"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/slds/salesforce-lightning-design-system-part4.css?{ versionKey }"/>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/dxp-site-spacing-styling-hooks.min.css?{ versionKey }" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/dxp-styling-hooks.min.css?{ versionKey }" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ basePath }/assets/styles/dxp-slds-extensions.min.css?{ versionKey }" />
<link rel="shortcut icon" href="{ basePath }/sfsites/c/resource/Ken42_Logo" type="image/x-icon"/>

<style>
/* ExtraLight - 200 */
@font-face {
  font-family: 'GeneralSans';
  src: url('/sfsites/c/resource/GeneralSansFont/fonts/GeneralSans-Extralight.woff2') format('woff2');
  font-weight: 200;
  font-style: normal;
  font-display: swap;
}

/* Light - 300 */
@font-face {
  font-family: 'GeneralSans';
  src: url('/sfsites/c/resource/GeneralSansFont/fonts/GeneralSans-Light.woff2') format('woff2');
  font-weight: 300;
  font-style: normal;
  font-display: swap;
}

/* Regular - 400 */
@font-face {
  font-family: 'GeneralSans';
  src: url('/sfsites/c/resource/GeneralSansFont/fonts/GeneralSans-Regular.woff2') format('woff2');
  font-weight: 400;
  font-style: normal;
  font-display: swap;
}

/* Medium - 500 */
@font-face {
  font-family: 'GeneralSans';
  src: url('/sfsites/c/resource/GeneralSansFont/fonts/GeneralSans-Medium.woff2') format('woff2');
  font-weight: 500;
  font-style: normal;
  font-display: swap;
}

/* SemiBold - 600 */
@font-face {
  font-family: 'GeneralSans';
  src: url('/sfsites/c/resource/GeneralSansFont/fonts/GeneralSans-Semibold.woff2') format('woff2');
  font-weight: 600;
  font-style: normal;
  font-display: swap;
}

/* Bold - 700 */
@font-face {
  font-family: 'GeneralSans';
  src: url('/sfsites/c/resource/GeneralSansFont/fonts/GeneralSans-Bold.woff2') format('woff2');
  font-weight: 700;
  font-style: normal;
  font-display: swap;
}

/* Override ALL CSS custom properties */
:root {
  --dxp-g-font-family: 'GeneralSans', sans-serif !important;
  --lwc-fontFamily: 'GeneralSans', sans-serif !important;
  --slds-g-font-family: 'GeneralSans', sans-serif !important;
  --dxp-c-font-family: 'GeneralSans', sans-serif !important;
}

/* Force GeneralSans everywhere but KEEP weights */
html,
body {
  font-family: 'GeneralSans', sans-serif !important;
}

*,
*::before,
*::after {
  font-family: 'GeneralSans', sans-serif !important;
}

.slds-scope,
.slds-scope *,
[class*="slds-"],
[class*="dxp-"],
.dxp *,
body * {
  font-family: 'GeneralSans', sans-serif !important;
}

/* Global scrollbar */
*::-webkit-scrollbar {
    width: 4px;
    height: 90%;
}
*::-webkit-scrollbar-track {
    background: transparent;
}
*::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb {
    background-color: rgba(232, 235, 243, 1);
    border-radius: 10px;
}
</style>

<!-- branding stylesheets -->
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ styles/styles.css }" />
<link rel="stylesheet" href="{ styles/print.css }" media="print"/>

<script>
(function () {
  var CONTAINER = 'kai-chatbot-container';
  var sdkLoading = null;
  function loadSdk(url) {
    if (window.KaiChatBot) { return Promise.resolve(); }
    if (!sdkLoading) {
      sdkLoading = new Promise(function (resolve, reject) {
        var tag = document.createElement('script');
        tag.src = url;
        tag.async = true;
        tag.onload = resolve;
        tag.onerror = function () { sdkLoading = null; reject(new Error('KAI SDK failed to load from ' + url)); };
        document.head.appendChild(tag);
      });
    }
    return sdkLoading;
  }
  function raise() {
    var el = document.getElementById(CONTAINER);
    if (el) { el.style.setProperty('z-index', '2147483647', 'important'); }
  }
  function unmount() {
    if (window.kenKai) { try { window.kenKai.unmount(); } catch (e) {} window.kenKai = undefined; }
    var el = document.getElementById(CONTAINER);
    if (el && el.parentNode) { el.parentNode.removeChild(el); }
  }
  window.addEventListener('kenkaichatmount', function (event) {
    var d = event.detail || {};
    if (!d.sdkUrl || !d.apiKey || !d.agentId) { return; }
    loadSdk(d.sdkUrl).then(function () {
      if (!window.KaiChatBot) { return; }
      unmount();
      var options = { apiKey: d.apiKey, agentId: d.agentId, persistence: { enabled: true, storage: 'session' } };
      if (d.baseUrl) { options.baseUrl = d.baseUrl; }
      if (d.userToken) { options.userToken = d.userToken; options.userId = d.userId; }
      window.kenKai = window.KaiChatBot.init(options);
      raise();
    }).catch(function (e) { console.error('kenKaiChat bridge: ' + (e && e.message)); });
  });
  window.addEventListener('kenkaichatupdate', function (event) {
    var d = event.detail || {};
    if (window.kenKai && d.userToken) { window.kenKai.update({ userToken: d.userToken }); }
  });
  window.addEventListener('kenkaichatunmount', unmount);
})();
</script>
